concept.title: When the charging connector is locked

section.title: Always lock mode
section.p: The connector locks when the charging connector is plugged into the charging inlet. The connector is locked until all doors are unlocked by the driver. This mode can be used to prevent charging cable theft.

li.p: If the charging connector is unlocked when all doors are unlocked, but the charging cable is not disconnected within 15 seconds, the connector will be automatically locked again.
If the charging connector is unlocked when all doors are unlocked, but all doors are locked again, immediately, the connector will be automatically locked again.

section.title: Lock while charging mode
section.p: The connector locks when charging starts. The connector unlocks when charging is complete. This mode can be used when charging in a public charging station.

section.title: Do not lock mode
section.p: The connector unlocks regardless of the state of charging. Press the charging connector release button, disconnect the connector. Be careful to theft of the charging cable.
